criteria.criterion: One function removes a given list of variable names from an environment ([]string of NAME=value), matching NAME= exactly so that a longer name sharing the prefix is kept; the gate run (runGate), the base gates (baseGates), the checks (runCheck) and the session launch (Session.Run) call it, and no other function filters an environment by matching "<NAME>=" prefixes.
criteria.evidence: dropEnv in internal/driver/safety.go matches n+"="; called from iterate.go runGate, acceptance.go baseGates, checks.go runCheck, session.go Run; grep finds no other HasPrefix(kv) filter

criteria.criterion: Each caller keeps its base environment and the set it drops today: the gate run its injected base else os.Environ, the base gates and the checks os.Environ, all three dropping VLOOP_ACTIVE_TASK and VLOOP_GATE_TASK; the session launch also drops VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 (PlanHashEnv).
